services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Enjoy the panoramic views of Myrtle Beach while parasailing! About Take in the panoramic views of North Myrtle Beach with us. The flight starts as you take off and land right on the boat. Dipping is optional (but definitely the best part!) Don’t be nervous, it takes no skill on your part. We do all the work. All you have to do is sit back and enjoy the view. A transfer from our double banana boat to the parasail boat is required to get you from the beach to where the action happens. Sea conditions are always evaluated if anyone questions their ability to ride. We’ve had passengers from 5 to 8-10 minute sail • All ages! • Great for groups and families
